rules.where: superseded by

top_fixes.rule: Say once the sentence; if repeated, close: before security questions declined (IDREF); after, no arrangement (TDN) with a `refused` note on every open product, no second look.
top_fixes.why: After verification, a repeated no-talk sets every open product to 'refused', and finalize then sends it to fin_refused (second look → TDN2L or TDN with a second-look offer), which breaks both the no-second-look rule and the plain TDN close; finalize also picks the reason from the first non-paid product instead of the most serious one.
top_fixes.fix: Policy ev_notalk: when c >= notalk_limit after verification, still write add_note reason 'refused' for each open/agreed product, but set the product state to 'notalk' (not 'refused') and set vars['final_route']='fin_tdn'. In finalize(), check final_route == 'fin_tdn' first and route to fin_tdn (outcome no_promise, reason TDN, farewell 'Thank you for your time, {{title}} {{last_name}}. Goodbye.') with no second look. Also change finalize to rank states by severity (service_error > hardship > dispute > refused > notalk/paid), sending 'refused' to fin_refused and treating paid next to turned-down as TDN/TDN2L. Make sure ask_dob/ask_phone_* task_message says 'This will only take a moment.' on the first no-talk and routes the second one to the IDREF close.

top_fixes.rule: With several products, agree, read back and record each product before moving to the next.
top_fixes.why: With several products, advance() calls start_product for the next open product before any read-back, so all products are read back and recorded at the end; this breaks the agree→read back→record order per product, and the 'Your payment arrangement is recorded.' sentence is not said after each successful create_promise.
top_fixes.fix: Policy advance()/agree(): when a product becomes 'agreed', go straight to the confirm node with readback_line for that product only ('So that is {amount} for your {product} on {weekday day month}. Is that right?'). On confirm=yes, run record_promise for it. In ev_rec_after on create_promise ok:true, speak 'Your payment arrangement is recorded.' (set it as the next on_enter line), and only then call start_product(V, opn[0]) for the next open product. Remove the batch read-back in enter_wrapup.

top_fixes.rule: `get_account` is refused until both questions are passed; if it fails, close as system failure.
top_fixes.why: nodes['load_account']['transitions'] is overwritten with [always('prepare')], so a failing get_account never reaches fin_service_error and the call cannot close as no_promise/SYSF.
top_fixes.fix: Generator: delete the line `nodes["load_account"]["transitions"] = [fl.always("prepare")]` (or replace it with an ordered list). load_account transitions must be: 1) -> fin_service_error if get_account_response.data.ok not_equals true/True (or get_account_failure_count greater_than 0); 2) always -> prepare. fin_service_error sets outcome=no_promise, reason=SYSF, and end_service_error speaks 'I'm sorry, our system is not responding. We will call you again. Goodbye.'

top_fixes.rule: Transferred to restructuring: `transferred`/`XRST`, sentence said before `transfer_to_agent`.
top_fixes.why: The transfer sentences ('I am putting you through now. Please stay on the line.' / '...to Customer Care now...') are on_enter tts of code nodes, which don't speak; also, identity-step transfers call transfer_to_agent directly with no sentence, so every transfer case misses its mandatory sentence before transfer_to_agent.
top_fixes.fix: Turn xfer_restructuring, xfer_general and xfer_support into api_request nodes: on_enter tts holds the sentence (XRST/XGEN: 'I am putting you through now. Please stay on the line.'; XCARE: 'I am putting you through to Customer Care now. Please stay on the line.') and pre_actions call transfer_to_agent with queue restructuring/general/support, then route to fin_transferred_*. In ask_dob/ask_phone_a/ask_phone_b, remove the transfer_to_agent tool and add an is_tool_call/intent transition to xfer_general for the second request for a person (or a 'no' to 'Are you happy to continue with me?'). Do the same in negotiate by setting human_pending in ev_human so the next 'no' goes to xfer_general and is not counted as a refusal.

top_fixes.rule: `add_note` reason is one of `refused`,`hardship`,`dispute`,`paid`,`service_error`; text must contain the listed content per reason.
top_fixes.why: note_text reads vars['customer_said'], but no node writes it, so the paid, dispute and hardship notes say '(not stated)' instead of how/when they paid, what is disputed, or the hardship in their own words.
top_fixes.fix: Add a free-text extraction field customer_said to the negotiate, confirm and hardship (pol_hardship) nodes: 'customer's own words: for already-paid, how and when they paid; for a dispute, what is disputed; for hardship, their circumstance'. In the negotiate task_message, on an already-paid claim, say 'Thank you. A payment can take up to two business days to reach us.' and ask how and when they paid before calling add_note. Have note_text use customer_said for reasons paid/dispute/hardship, and keep 'number of attempts and last offer amount+date' for refused and 'create_promise, number of tries: N' for service_error.
